val water = Avogadro.molecule("example:water") { builder =>
      builder.smiles("[H]O[H]")
          .itemTags("example:water_items")
          .fluidTags("example:water_fluids")
    }
    val job = AvogadroApi.owner("example_recipes")
          .submit(true, batch =>
      batch.register(water)
          .remove("example:old_water")
          .itemTag("example:water_items", false, "minecraft:water_bucket")
          .fluidTag("example:water_fluids", false, "water")
    )
    job.onComplete(outcome =>
      if outcome.state() == RegistrationJob.State.SUCCEEDED then
        println(s"Published revision ${outcome.view().revision()}")
      else if outcome.failure() != null then System.err.println(outcome.failure())
    )
    job

import io.github.wurtzitane.avogadro.api.*
import io.github.wurtzitane.avogadro.scala.Avogadro
import io.github.wurtzitane.avogadro.molecule.BondType

object TypedNetworkRecipeS:
  // Common CPU authoring; native Scala uses the same validated Java fragment and assembly models.
  def recipe(): PolymerNetworkDefinition =
    val fragment = Avogadro.fragment { builder =>
      builder.atom("C", 0, 0, 0)
          .attachment("head", 0)
          .attachment("tail", 0)
    }
    val unit = Avogadro.assembly(_.part("unit", fragment))
    val assembly = Avogadro.assembly { builder =>
      builder.repeat("chain", unit, "length", StructureAssembly.translation(1.5, 0, 0))
          .neighbor("unit/tail", "unit/head", 1, BondType.SINGLE)
    }
    new PolymerNetworkDefinition(java.util.List.of(
      PolymerNetworkDefinition.Parameter.count("length", 1, 8, 3)), assembly, 42)
  // Common CPU realization, without registry or GPU side effects.
  def preview(recipe: PolymerNetworkDefinition): PolymerPreview =
    recipe.preview(new NetworkPreviewRequest(java.util.Map.of("length",
                Int.box(4)),
            java.util.Map.of(),
            7))
